jobs.title: Financial Controls Accountant

jobs.title: Senior Associate / Manager, Responsible Sourcing Client Management
jobs.reason: This role is a poor fit due to a significant mismatch in both field and experience level. jobs.title: Inspection Coordinator

The candidate's academic and research focus on international relations and social policy is entirely misaligned with this techno-commercial inspection coordination role.

jobs.title: Head of Initial Teacher Education

While the candidate has strong research and administrative skills related to higher education policy, their academic background and experience do not align with the specific field of Initial Teacher Education or the leadership responsibilities of a "Head of" role.

jobs.title: Coordinator

While the candidate possesses many transferable skills like organization, communication, and MS Office proficiency, the role requires a minimum of 2 years of experience in a similar role, which the candidate's student assistant experience (approx. 1 year 7 months) does not fully meet. jobs.title: LSE Fellow in International Social and Public Policy
jobs.organisation: London School of Economics and Political Science
jobs.reason: While the candidate's academic interests in international relations, policy research, sociology, and political science align well with the department's multidisciplinary approach, there are critical gaps in the required qualifications. Additionally, the candidate lacks explicit teaching experience at the university level, which is a key requirement for this academic fellowship.
